params.1274: Get a staff. (You can get an Air Staff by killing monsters around Burthorpe).
params.1275: Click on your inventory to open that sidebar, then click on the staff to wield it.
params.1276: You can see your equipped staff in the equipment screen, and remove it if you wish by clicking on it again.
params.2225: Some staves provide an infinite supply of a rune needed to cast certain spells, e.g. the air staff gives you unlimited air runes and the members-only Mindspike can provide air, fire, earth or water runes.
